title: G7 formal preflight accepted colliding source_run_id references
evidence: Before repair, changing every source_run_id in the immutable formal-plan-shaped input to the same nonempty identifier still returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[] under the strict formal-input preflight. The actual frozen retry plan has one distinct source_run_id per plan row, as required by the source-plan builder and audit manifest.
remediation: Require unique source_run_id values across formal retry rows, retain shared source_checkpoint_id only at the intended case/group fork boundary, add an adversarial collision test, and independently verify the immutable plan.
